auto-fade-options-dialog:
Auto-Fade Options


Configure automated fade sequences for presentations and demos. Set display duration, wait delays, background/foreground colors, custom text messages, and optional effects like logo zoom or text zoom. Choose to close the toolbar after starting the sequence.
confirmation-dialog:
Confirmation


Confirm or cancel the requested action. Review the details and click your preferred option.
dialog-add-child:
Add Child Node


Add a new child node to the selected parent. Enter the node name and any additional properties.
dialog-add-player:
Add Team Member


Add a new player to the team roster. Enter player details including name, position, jersey number, and contact information.
dialog-combine-datasets:
Combine Datasets


Merge multiple datasets into a single combined dataset. Select source datasets and configure merge options.
dialog-create-dataset:
Create Dataset


Create a new decision flow dataset. Enter dataset name, description, and ownership settings.
dialog-create-lesson:
Create Lesson


Create a new lesson for the selected nodes or flow. Enter lesson title, description, and configure lesson settings.
dialog-create-team:
Create Team


Create a new team within your organization. Enter team name, description, and initial settings.
dialog-create-team-group:
Create Team Group


Create a new team group for organizing players. Enter group name and description.
dialog-edit-dataset:
Edit Dataset


Modify dataset properties including name, description, and ownership settings. Save changes or cancel to discard.
dialog-edit-lesson:
Edit Lesson


Modify lesson details including title, description, node sequence, and settings. Save changes or cancel to discard.
dialog-edit-team:
Edit Team


Modify team details including name, description, and settings. Save changes or cancel to discard.
dialog-edit-team-group:
Edit Team Group


Modify team group details including name and description. Save changes or cancel to discard.
dialog-delete-team:
Delete Team


Permanently delete the selected team. This action cannot be undone. Confirm or cancel the deletion.
dialog-delete-team-group:
Delete Team Group


Permanently delete the selected team group. This action cannot be undone. Confirm or cancel the deletion.
dialog-favorites-manager:
Favorites Manager


Organize and manage your saved favorite techniques. Add, remove, or reorder favorites across different categories (Movements, Match Skills, Techniques).
dialog-lesson-assign:
Assign Lesson


Assign the selected lesson to team members or groups. Choose recipients and set assignment parameters.
dialog-lesson-assignment:
Lesson Assignment Details


View and manage lesson assignment details including assigned members, due dates, and completion status.
dialog-lesson-runner:
Lesson Runner


Run through structured lessons step-by-step. Navigate forward/backward through lesson nodes, watch videos, and mark completion.
dialog-lesson-survey:
Lesson Survey


Provide feedback on the completed lesson. Rate difficulty, usefulness, and provide comments about your learning experience.
dialog-node-explorer:
Node Explorer


Explore node details, content, and relationships. View node properties, parent/child connections, and related information.
dialog-edit-player:
Edit Player


Modify player details including name, position, jersey number, contact information, and demographics. Save changes or cancel to discard.
dialog-reparent-node:
Reparent Node


Move the selected node to a new parent location in the tree structure. Select the new parent node and confirm the operation.
